_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows Jules reminder details and account state in a compact card.

description: Generate a Jules setup link for a connected Jules user so they can finish setup, verify their number, and save the reminder on heyjules.app.

phoneNumber.description: Optional phone number to prefill. Include country code when possible.

time.description: Reminder time in 24-hour HH:MM format. Only use this after the user has provided or confirmed an exact time.

timeExpression.description: The user's original time wording, preserved exactly, such as '4:00 PM' or '16:00'. If the user said something fuzzy like 'later this afternoon', ask a follow-up instead of calling this tool.

name: prepare_jules_reminder
title: Prepare a Jules reminder
